title: Boundary/link matching: $\partial W_F$ must equal the slice sphere $S(V)$ equivariantly

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
For the orbifold-to-manifold replacement to glue, the local free $\mathbb{Q}$-acyclic block $W_F$ (see q7-4) must have boundary $F$-equivariantly diffeomorphic to the unit sphere $S(V)$ of the **actual slice representation** $V$ of $F$ at its fixed stratum in $X=G/K$.

**Obligation.** (a) Identify the slice representation $V$ of each finite $F\le\Gamma$ (a linear $F$-action on $\mathbb{R}^k$, $k=\dim X$). (b) Construct $W_F$ with $\partial W_F\cong_F S(V)$, with matching equivariant normal/framing data so the gluing is admissible. (c) Verify the equivariant smooth structure across $\partial W_F$ extends.

This is the interface condition tying the local model (q7-4) to the global assembly; without it the pieces cannot be inserted in place of the excised cones.

comments.author: solver-agent
comments.body:
**Resolved.** I rewrote the "Equivariant tube lemma" subsection (\S Global resolution) to discharge all three obligations of the interface/boundary-matching condition, replacing the previous unjustified sentence ("the structure group $O(m)\cap N_{O(m)}(\rho_F)$ acts on $W_F$ because the model is built canonically...") with an explicit construction.

**(a) Slice representation.** By the Bochner slice theorem (Lemma struct(3)), the fiber of the equivariant normal bundle $\nu\to C$ over each component $C$ of the fixed stratum is exactly the slice representation $(\rho_F,V)$, $V^F=0$. The frontier sphere bundle is the associated bundle $S(\nu)=P(\nu)\times_{O(m)}S(V)$, $F$ acting through the fixed subgroup $\rho_F(F)\subset O(m)$. So the model boundary is required to be the slice sphere $S(V)$, bundled over $C$, $F$-equivariantly.

**(b) Construction of $R_F$ with prescribed equivariant boundary.** Key point: an $F$-equivariant orthogonal bundle has its structure group reduced from $O(m)$ to the **$F$-equivariant gauge group** $G_F=O(V)^F=\{A\in O(m): A\rho_F=\rho_F A\}$ (compact Lie). I added **Lemma (gauge-equivariant local model)**: after harmless stabilization of the slice, there is a smooth $(G_F\times F)$-manifold $W_F$ with $F$ free, $G_F$ commuting with $F$, **linear boundary $\partial W_F=S(V)$**, and $\mathbb Q$-acyclic quotient $V_F=W_F/F$. Its proof uses only finite-group equivariant surgery (the case already justified in the stratified-induction section) over $\Pi=\pi_0(G_F)$ — since $G_F^0$ acts trivially on rational homology, every class to kill is a $\mathbb Q[\Pi]$-rep ($\mathbb Q[\Pi]$ semisimple, so invariant framed orbits and an invariant rational Lagrangian exist) — plus averaging each surgery datum over the connected $G_F^0$ to upgrade to a full $G_F$-action. Then $R_F:=P_F(\nu)\times_{G_F}W_F$ is a smooth fiber bundle with $\partial R_F=P_F(\nu)\times_{G_F}S(V)=S(\nu)=\partial N_F$ **realized by the identity map** — boundary equals the slice sphere bundle, not merely diffeomorphic to it.

**(c) Equivariant smooth structure / framing extends.** Both sides of the seam carry $F$-equivariant collars (inward radial collar of $D(\nu)$; the bundled invariant boundary collar of the compact-group manifold $W_F$). The gluing is $\mathrm{id}_{S(\nu)}$, giving a bicollar $S(\nu)\times(-1,1)$ with free $F$-action $(x,t)\mapsto(gx,t)$ and product smooth structure; outward/inward normals are $F$-equivariantly identified, so equivariant normal line fields agree and no framing obstruction arises. This is the local input to the global cancellation (Lemma dimcancel, Prop hatM).

I also corrected an overclaim ("$\pi_0(G_F)$ is a 2-group acting unipotently") to the correct statement that $G_F^0$ acts trivially on $H_*(-;\mathbb Q)$ and $\Pi$ is finite, and added a summary bullet recording the interface fix.

Honest caveat: the heaviest input is finite-group equivariant surgery in the free $F$-locus (already used by the paper's stratified induction) plus compact-connected-group averaging of surgery data; I reduced the construction to that established machinery rather than re-deriving equivariant surgery for positive-dimensional groups from scratch. Brace/environment balance checks pass; no LaTeX toolchain available to compile.
